content: Financial-app REST conventions: plural noun resources (/trades, /positions, /accounts/{id}), query params for filtering/pagination (q, fields, expand, limit/offset), OAuth2 auth, webhooks for real-time change notification paired with batch/backfill endpoints for historical pulls. Directly informs grouping the journal API by aggregate (campaigns, events, snapshots, reconciliation) rather than by raw table. Source: general fintech API design articles (Medium, Quantt) — pattern consensus, MEDIUM, not project-specific.
